about_the_game:
WARNING: THIS DLC ISN'T COMPLETE YET - MORE CONTENT FOR IT COMING SOON!



THIS DLC COMES WITH SOME EXTRA GOODIES:

DEVILS DOORSTEP MODE:
One giant map with 4 branching paths, each path leads to a key. Collect all 4 keys and get to the devil, slay him - and win.

Only one problem - got to do it one life!

Can you survive, and make it out alive - MOST CAN'T!
Completing the DLC unlocks one character not seen in standard edition!

OCTOPUS GAME MODE:
Welcome to Octopus Game. Where you have to survive 2 levels of Simon Says, with a twist, this time this childrens game has a severe penalty - death!


WITH MORE MODES COMING IN THE FUTURE!

content_descriptors.notes: It has gore and violence, and profanity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-1300F
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 510
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Stomp skulls as zany characters in a chaotic adventure that spares no one—no political sides taken, just unapologetic, good old-fashioned stomping! Now choose from 12 characters (instead of original 6), each with unique stats and dialogue. Also includes NEW "DEVILS DOORSTEP" mode.
